|errata_history=This is the original printed text. The later errata version is [[Crush The Rebellion (V) (Virtual Block 4) (Errata)]] (PC-E1, the current text). The release-sheet slip and the Players Committee card image on this page show this text. No published image shows the errata text; [[Crush The Rebellion (V) (Virtual Block 4) (Errata)]] uses a CardMaker recreation ([[:File:VB4-20-Crush_The_Rebellion-PC-E1-cardmaker.png]]).
* '''Original''' (this page): text as given in the Virtual Block 4 release sheet (official text as of 7 December 2009): “Deploy on table. May place an Imperial Council Member here from hand. Once per turn, if a logistics agenda or general here, may subtract X from forfeit and immunity to attrition of a character at a site for remainder of turn, where X = total influence at Conference Room.”.<ref name="sheet-VirtualBlock4">[https://res.starwarsccg.org/legacyblocks/VirtualBlock4.pdf Virtual Block 4 release sheet] ("Official text as of 7 December 2009"). Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20261027095223/https://res.starwarsccg.org/legacyblocks/VirtualBlock4.pdf Internet Archive]</ref> The Master List (official text as of 27 April 2013) prints this text again. That copy is a stale reprint, not a new version, because the PC website card list already showed the later text of [[Crush The Rebellion (V) (Virtual Block 4) (Errata)]] (wiki versions ruling, 8 November 2026).<ref name="ml-ds">[[Media:Virtual_Legacy_Final_Master_DS.pdf|Players Committee Virtual Cards Master List (Dark Side)]], cover "official text as of April 27, 2013" (PDF built February 2014). Original: http://www.starwarsccg.org/Resources/MasterDS.pdf. Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20170704232650/http://www.starwarsccg.org/Resources/MasterDS.pdf Internet Archive]</ref>
* '''PC-E1''' ([[Crush The Rebellion (V) (Virtual Block 4) (Errata)]]): The PC website card list (shown there by 21 July 2012, the earliest archived capture with text, and still on 11 January 2013) changed “a logistics agenda or general” to “a general or logistics agenda” and “from forfeit” to “from the forfeit”: “Deploy on table. May place an Imperial Council Member here from hand. Once per turn, if a general or logistics agenda here, may subtract X from the forfeit and immunity to attrition of a character at a site for remainder of turn, where X = total influence at Conference Room.”.<ref name="cl-1240_22-2012-07-21">Players Committee website card list (VBlock4Type), as captured [https://web.archive.org/web/20120721064721/http://www.starwarsccg.org:80/cardlists/VBlock4Type.html 2012-07-21] (Internet Archive)</ref>
